questions.stem: Which organisation launched about 35 more rockets in 2023 compared to 2022?
choices: SpaceX
Arianespace
United Launch Alliance
Galactic Energy
questions.solution: SpaceX is the correct answer because it is known to have significantly increased its rocket launches in 2023 compared to 2022. Arianespace has consistently reduced its launch frequency, and United Launch Alliance saw a decline in launches during the same period. Galactic Energy is not recognized for such a large increase in rocket launches during this time.

questions.stem: What is the average number of bounces of the ball that Shreyas is able to make with his bat? The data is 6, 2, 9, 5, 4, 6, 3, 5.
questions.solution: The average is calculated by adding all the values and dividing by the number of values. The sum of the data is 6 + 2 + 9 + 5 + 4 + 6 + 3 + 5 = 40. There are 8 values, so 40 ÷ 8 = 5.0. The correct answer is 5.0. Adding the values but not dividing by the count would give 40. Adding the denominators instead of the numerators would give 5.5. Confusing the sum with the count would give 6.0.

hi.stem: श्रेयस द्वारा अपनी बैट से बॉल के लुढ़कन की औसत संख्या क्या है? डेटा 6, 2, 9, 5, 4, 6, 3, 5 है।
hi.solution: औसत की गणना सभी मानों को जोड़कर और मानों की संख्या से विभाजित करके की जाती है। डेटा का योग 6 + 2 + 9 + 5 + 4 + 6 + 3 + 5 = 40 है। 8 मान हैं, इसलिए 40 ÷ 8 = 5.0। सही उत्तर 5.0 है। मानों को जोड़ लेना लेकिन गिनती से विभाजित न करना 40 देगा। अंश के स्थान पर हर को जोड़ लेना 5.5 देगा। योग के साथ गिनती को भ्रमित करना 6.0 देगा।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: What is the meaning of the term 'median' in the context of data analysis?
choices: The sum of all values divided by the number of values
The most frequently occurring value
The middle value when data is arranged in order
The value that appears most frequently in the data set
questions.solution: The median is the middle value when data is arranged in order from smallest to largest. It is not the sum of values (mean), the most frequent value (mode), or the range (difference between highest and lowest).

questions.stem: How much do onion prices vary across shops in the same area?
choices: It depends on the shop
It is always the same
It is always different
It is not possible to know
questions.solution: Onion prices can vary depending on the shop due to factors like location, supply, and pricing strategies. The idea that prices are always the same or always different is too rigid and doesn't account for real-world variability. 'It is not possible to know' is overly absolute and doesn't reflect the reasonable expectation that some variation exists. The most accurate choice is 'It depends on the shop.'

questions.stem: Which of the following is a statistical question?
choices: What is the price of a tennis ball in India?
How old are the dogs that live on this street?
What fraction of the students in your class like walking up a hill?
Do you like reading?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'How old are the dogs that live on this street?' because it requires collecting data about the ages of dogs. The other options are not statistical questions because they do not require data collection or analysis. 'What is the price of a tennis ball in India?' is a factual question. 'What fraction of the students in your class like walking up a hill?' is a statistical question, but it is not the correct option here. 'Do you like reading?' is a personal preference question.

questions.stem: In a cricket series, Shubman scored 110 runs in 5 matches and Yashasvi scored 96 runs in 4 matches. What is the average number of runs scored by Yashasvi in a match?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 24. The average is calculated by dividing the total runs by the number of matches. Yashasvi scored 96 runs in 4 matches, so 96 ÷ 4 = 24. The other options are incorrect because they do not result from the correct calculation. 21 is the average for Shubman, 25 and 28 are not the result of the division.

hi.stem: एक क्रिकेट श्रृंखला में, शुभम 5 मैचों में 110 रन बनाये और यशस्वी 4 मैचों में 96 रन बनाये। यशस्वी द्वारा एक मैच में बनाए गए रनों की औसत कितनी है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 24 है। औसत की गणना कुल रनों को मैचों की संख्या से भाग देकर की जाती है। यशस्वी ने 4 मैचों में 96 रन बनाए, इसलिए 96 ÷ 4 = 24। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सही गणना से प्राप्त नहीं होते हैं। 21 शुभम के लिए औसत है, 25 और 28 भाग देने के परिणाम नहीं हैं।

questions.stem: In a data set with an even number of values, the median is the average of the two middle numbers. What happens if the two middle numbers are the same?
choices: The median is the same as the mean.
The median is the same as the middle number.
The median is not defined.
The median is the sum of the two middle numbers.
questions.solution: If the two middle numbers are the same, the average of them is that number itself. So the median is the same as the middle number. 'The median is the same as the mean' is incorrect because the mean and median can be different. 'The median is not defined' is incorrect because the median is always defined. 'The median is the sum of the two middle numbers' is incorrect because the median is the average, not the sum.
